description: Single-strand roller-chain sprocket per ISO 606 / DIN 8187: toothed disc (ISO 606 §8.2 tooth form) with optional one-sided hub, center bore, and DIN 6885A keyway on hard tier. Reference design for the table-driven parameter pattern.
source: ISO 606 Table 1 (B-series chains) + §8.2 tooth equations; DIN 6885 Form A key seats; catalog form: single sprockets 5/8" x 3/8" DIN/ISO 606 ready-to-install (one-sided hub)
